chronologicalSplitPolicy: NONE -- this milestone is a pooled retrospective descriptive/exploratory analysis over the full corpus, not a chronological train/holdout confirmatory test (see evidenceLevel/experimentType)
eligibilityCriteria: settlementStatus == SETTLED with settlementResult in (YES, NO)
contemporaneousEdge is not null (both modelFairProbability and this checkpoint's own executable price available)
side defaults/resolves to YES (no NO-side causally-linked rows exist in this corpus as of this experiment)
PRIMARY predictive scoring additionally requires fairMarketProbability (both yesBid and yesAsk present at this checkpoint) -- see coverage.fairMarketBenchmark
exclusionCriteria: No causally-valid ModelEvaluation for this checkpoint (NO_EVALUATIONS_FOR_TICKER / NO_CAUSAL_TIMESTAMP_ON_ANY_CANDIDATE / ALL_EVALUATIONS_AFTER_CHECKPOINT)
Missing executable price at this checkpoint
Missing yesBid or yesAsk (excluded from the fair-market-benchmark population specifically, reported as coverage loss)
hypothesis: Larger declared model edge (contemporaneousEdge, model probability minus this checkpoint's own executable market price) corresponds to a larger genuine predictive advantage of the model over the market's contemporaneous fair-value (bid/ask midpoint) probability estimate (a more negative model-minus-market paired Brier/log-loss delta), and this relationship is not uniform across canonical market families -- evaluated separately for the CURRENT model (TRUSTED_PRODUCTION qualityTier) and for the full historical mixed-model-version corpus, since these are distinct claims.
notes: Registered evidenceLevel is E1_RECONSTRUCTED_RETROSPECTIVE, not E2, because model_evaluation_probability_prospective_snapshot carries pitStatus=PROSPECTIVE_ONLY in the Milestone 0A PIT manifest, which lib.edgelab.pit_provenance.check_predictive_compatibility does not certify as PIT-safe for a PREDICTIVE_INPUT role at E2/E3, and ~60% of this experiment's usable rows come from that pathway. A recommendations-artifactSource-only subset is reported separately as 'PIPELINE_TIMING_COMPATIBLE_SUBSET' (never 'E2-eligible' -- its upstream model inputs remain UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_AUDIT; only the pipelineRunId<=checkpoint timing is proven). Do not force E2 by omitting this input's honest status. The report's official disposition is driven by the TRUSTED_PRODUCTION_QUALITY_TIER_ONLY (current-model) classification, never the pooled ALL_HISTORICAL_MODEL_VERSIONS one -- see secondaryMetrics.headline.
primaryMetric: pairedBrierDelta_modelMinusMarket vs the fair-market (bid/ask midpoint) benchmark (game-clustered, by preregistered edge bucket); executable-price is a secondary sensitivity analysis only
researchQuestion: Does larger declared model edge correspond to genuinely greater predictive advantage over the Kalshi market, and does that relationship differ by market family? (Current-model and historical-mixed-version evidence are reported and classified separately -- never conflated.)
secondaryMetrics: positiveEdgeTrend (Spearman rank correlation, game-clustered bootstrap CI)
secondaryFeeAdjustedEconomics (ROI/P&L, explicitly non-primary, executable price + canonical fees)
targetPopulation: Every settled MLB Kalshi opportunity row in the archived observation corpus with a causally-valid (no-look-ahead) model probability -- reported for ALL_HISTORICAL_MODEL_VERSIONS, POSITIVE_EDGE_ONLY, CANONICAL_ERA, and TRUSTED_PRODUCTION_QUALITY_TIER_ONLY as distinct populations
